originality.rationale: The directly matching October 2026 primary work uses a strictly weaker factor 2/e^3 and consequent prime-gap 11M. Here the optimal factor 1/2 is proved with matching asymptotic examples and yields gap 2M. The 2012 related maximum-product literature has a different constraint, and checked published research records yielded no covering implication; priority remains conditional on the scope of historical literature.

value.rationale: Identifies the sharp coefficient in a natural integer-set sum/product inequality used centrally in a recent prime partition proof; nontrivially improves its sufficient prime gap by a factor exceeding five (11M to 2M).
